products.name: Lovo (Genny)
products.note: Voice cloning and synthesis; likeness consent; commercial voiceover; synthetic media disclosure

reading.body:
Lovo offers voice cloning and synthesis software, positioning itself in the synthetic media layer above compute infrastructure rather than in compute, power, or buildings themselves.

The company's focus on voice cloning and commercial voiceover production addresses demand for synthetic media that reduces reliance on human talent for certain content workflows. Its inclusion of likeness consent and synthetic media disclosure suggests awareness that regulatory and ethical frameworks around AI-generated voice are still forming. This sits downstream of the raw compute that enables the technology, not at the constraint point.

The data provided covers only Lovo's current product category and does not include information on its compute requirements, infrastructure partnerships, scale of deployment, or power consumption. It does not show whether Lovo trains models or relies on third-party compute, or how its operations relate to data center capacity constraints. Without this information, the relationship between Lovo's growth and grid or building limitations cannot be determined from these facts alone.
